xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5359: Per-turn memory injection for project-root conversations and Codex

plan.title: Per-turn memory injection for project-root conversations and Codex
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Codex turns get no per-turn memory: nothing in src/lib/codex calls /api/memory/inject. Project-root Claude conversations already call the route through the global user-prompt-submit-hook (740 injected decisions for overdeck roots). But conversations in the 12 of 24 projects on this machine with no kind='main' workspace row (mind-your-now, lexerra, papers-please, auricle, tindra, krux, myn-cli, orca, pan-tts, puzzdom, eltmon-stream, eltmon-video) resolve no memory identity, so they get nothing. The route also cannot find a Codex conversation before its thread id is a recorded conversation_files locator.
narratives.Proposal: Share one conversation memory-identity resolver (workspace row, else cwd match) and let the inject route also resolve a conversation by name (body.conversation). Backfill missing main workspace rows at dashboard boot. Give the Codex app-server host a fail-open client that calls /api/memory/inject before each host-mediated turn and wraps the result in an <overdeck-turn-context> block, which readCodexRolloutMessage strips so the timeline, titles and search show only the operator's text. Lock the Claude path with a registration regression test. Document per-turn retrieval by harness. The conversation-page indicator (proposal 3) is split out to PAN-5366.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new hook in project or workspace .claude/settings.json files and no change to the global user-prompt-submit-hook script
- No conversation-page indicator (PAN-5366)
- No fix for zero-hit results in projects with an empty memory corpus (dfai) or for provider-auth-failed query expansion (PAN-4370)
- No injection for turns typed in the native Codex terminal companion, for codex.transport: tui, or for Codex sub-agent messages
- No change to Pi conversation injection, including Pi project-root conversations without an issue
- No change to resolveWorkspaceForCwd's handling of archived rows
- No observation capture (Stop hook) for project-root conversations
- No edit to src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts and no file-size allowlist raise

autoDecisions.summary: Proposal 1 (install the prompt-inject hook for project conversations) is reframed as an identity fix: no new Claude hook is installed.
autoDecisions.rationale: The global user-prompt-submit-hook in ~/.claude/settings.json already posts every Claude prompt to /api/memory/inject in any cwd (rag-runs show 740 injected decisions for overdeck root conversations and 24,981 zero-hit decisions for dfai roots). A project .claude/settings.json hook would double the calls and dirty tracked files (dfai tracks it). The real gap is identity: projects with no main workspace row and Codex conversations found only by name.

autoDecisions.summary: Codex calls the existing /api/memory/inject route over HTTP from the app-server host instead of running injectPromptTimeMemory in-process.
autoDecisions.rationale: The route already owns identity resolution, compliance warning, briefing update, docs context, the 750 ms fast path and rag-runs logging, so Claude and Codex share one server path.

autoDecisions.summary: Injection sits in CodexAppServerHost.handleMessageOp; the native Codex terminal, codex.transport: tui and sub-agent messages are NonGoals.
autoDecisions.rationale: handleMessageOp is the single choke point for dashboard messages, pan tell and pane lines. A Codex UserPromptSubmit hook would need per-launch trust hashes in every CODEX_HOME and shares hooks.json with SageOx.

autoDecisions.summary: Injected context rides in the user input inside one <overdeck-turn-context> block that readCodexRolloutMessage strips.
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck's turn/start sends only threadId, input, model and effort, with no per-turn instruction slot. One wrapper plus one reader-side strip keeps the timeline, titles, search and enrichment clean in both rollout shapes.

autoDecisions.summary: Missing kind='main' workspace rows are created at dashboard boot through createWorkspace.
autoDecisions.rationale: Synthesizing an identity would orphan memory homes, and asking the operator to run pan project finish-setup per project leaves an invisible gap. createWorkspace already refuses a second main row.

autoDecisions.summary: The conversation-page indicator (proposal 3) is split into sibling issue PAN-5366.
autoDecisions.rationale: It needs a new route, a frontend component and scope rows, which pushes this plan past finalize's six-subsystem limit. The issue's acceptance list does not require it, and the swarm contract prefers independently shippable siblings.

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation identities keep issueId null and workspace-row keying.
autoDecisions.rationale: This preserves current cross-workspace sibling search for conversations; changing identity keying is out of scope.

Fail-open Codex prompt-memory client that calls /api/memory/inject

expected_outputs: prompt-memory.test.ts passes including the fake-timer timeout case

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-4. Create src/lib/codex/prompt-memory.ts with applyCodexPromptMemory(input, deps) exactly as the PRD snippet shows. It POSTs { prompt, sessionId, agentId, conversation? } to `${baseUrl}/api/memory/inject` with the internal-token header. baseUrl is deps.baseUrl, else env.OVERDECK_DASHBOARD_URL, else getDashboardLoopbackApiUrl() from src/lib/config.ts; never getDashboardApiUrl(), whose DASHBOARD_URL fallback can be a stale public URL. The request runs under an AbortController + setTimeout timeout of 1500 ms (never AbortSignal.timeout). It returns { text: wrapCodexTurnContext(context, prompt), contextChars } on an OK response with ok: true and a non-empty context, and { text: prompt, contextChars: 0 } on every other path: blank prompt, OVERDECK_BARE_CONTEXT=1, no token, rejection, non-OK status, bad body, empty context, or unwrappable context. Write the WI-4 tests with all deps injected and vi.useFakeTimers() for the timeout case.

items.title: Given a 202 response { ok: true, context: 'MEM' }, applyCodexPromptMemory returns the wrapped text with contextChars 3 and the request body carries prompt, sessionId, agentId and conversation plus the x-overdeck-internal-token header
Given OVERDECK_BARE_CONTEXT=1 or no internal token, applyCodexPromptMemory returns the original prompt and never calls fetch
Given a fetch rejection, HTTP 500, empty context, or context containing </overdeck-turn-context>, applyCodexPromptMemory falls back to the original prompt with contextChars 0
Given a fetch that settles only on abort, advancing fake timers by 1500 ms makes applyCodexPromptMemory resolve with the original prompt
